policy: Prefer official validation/test splits; select by existing source-boundary rule, not model scores

identity_rules.AM-2k: Original stem, independent of fg/mask/original/trimap role or extension
identity_rules.BG-20k: Original author image stem, independent of split or mirror container
identity_rules.VideoMatte240K: Official split + video stem; fgr/pha share identity; every frame of a source video is excluded together
identity_rules.derived_assets: Must retain original source_id and raw provenance; a crop name or another frame range never creates a new source

AM-2k.foreground_rgb_status: Not supplied in official validation; E7 must estimate foreground colors using original RGB and Alpha. Do not use original RGB as already-separated foreground.

VideoMatte240K.grouping: Only five official source videos; multiple clips from one video remain the same statistical source group

remaining_E7_work: Derive and validate AM foreground RGB without tuning on baseline test scores
Choose final scene combinations, source-video frame ranges, geometry/focus/K and scene count
Freeze final scene manifest and scoring configuration; do not treat source-pool reservation as benchmark freeze
limits: No claim that pretrained baselines never saw these datasets
Official source-video namespace trusted; not a person-identity or original-recording-session split
